cv.title: CV
cv.description: CV for Mikkel Nothlev Elvers, a junior web developer based in the {{location}}, who builds whole products, from the database to the interface.
cv.profile: Junior web developer who builds whole products, from the database to the interface. I work in TypeScript across React, Next.js and SvelteKit on the front end, and Express, Hono and PostgreSQL on the back end. I care about readable code, clear abstractions and understanding the technology behind what I ship.

projects.name: Sora
bullets: Designed and built a self-hosted anime library as a versioned HTTP API with a typed SDK, a SvelteKit web client and a PostgreSQL-backed job scheduler.
Wrote an authenticated stream proxy using encrypted, expiring, account-bound tokens, with segment read-ahead and subtitle retiming between encodes.
Deployed the web app, API and scheduler as separate containers, with over 400 tests and a type-checked client.

projects.name: HiFi Horizon
bullets: Full-stack webshop for browsing and comparing hi-fi products before adding them to a cart and checking out.
Implemented search, filtering, comparison, user profiles, order history and authentication.
Built the Express API connecting the React front end to PostgreSQL data for users, products and orders.

projects.name: Newsify
bullets: Mobile news reader on The New York Times' Top Stories and Most Popular APIs, grouped by category.
Implemented search with Fuse.js, data fetching with React Query and a swipe-based archive.
Persisted theme, selected categories and archive state between sessions.

projects.name: Escape Room
bullets: Team project built to a school brief: a browser game in which a "compromised" bank website must be fixed within five minutes by solving 10 short CSS puzzles, each revealing part of a lock code.
Front end in React with Vite, GSAP animation, background music and a countdown timer.
Leaderboard server on Bun and Express with SQLite, with Zod-validated names, a banned-word filter and rate limiting.
